Assets.DESCRIPTION[CCP5_ResidentialMediu: This elegant building showcases a classic architectural style with intricate moldings, decorative balconies, and a harmonious facade. Exclusively residential, it offers comfortable apartments that blend historical charm with modern living, providing a serene urban dwelling experience.

Neoclassical building with an elegant facade and grand windows. Originally commercial, it's now a sophisticated residential space. Its symmetrical design and ornate details make it a key landmark, blending historical charm with modern amenities in the heart of the city.

Historical building featuring a blend of neoclassical and baroque architectural styles. It boasts ornate arched windows, elegant columns, and detailed cornices. Once a public institution, this majestic structure has been transformed into luxurious residential apartments.

A grand neoclassical building, known for its symmetrical facade, stately columns, and ornate decorations. Originally a civic center, it has been transformed into a luxurious residential complex, blending historical elegance with modern living.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[CCP5_TrainStation]: An historic station with impressive arches and detailed facades. Combining neoclassical and Mediterranean architecture, it serves as a transportation hub with extensive rail connections. Can be upgraded with additional tracks and a glass and iron shed, enhancing its capacity and functionality.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[CCP5_ElementarySchool: Traditional Mediterranean school for children. Provides the first level of education. Can be upgraded with an extension wing.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[CCP5_HighSchool]:
A Mediterranean school for teenage scholars, blending classical elegance with modern amenities. Provides second level education.
Can be upgraded with an extra floor.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[CCP5_HighScho: An additional floor for more space for students.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[CCP5_PoliceStation]: This facility serves as a hub for local police operations. Featuring classic architectural elements, it houses staff facilities, two attached garages for police vehicles, and a small jail. It can be upgraded with additional garages, jail space, and office expansion to accommodate growing needs.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[CCP5_PoliceSt: Additional garages, jail space, and office expansion.
